mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_message (sender_id, receiver_id, content, msg_type, is_read, read_at, created_at) VALUES (#{senderId}, #{receiverId}, #{content}, IFNULL(#{msgType}, 1), IFNULL(#{isRead}, 0), #{readAt}, IFNULL(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))
mapper.select: SELECT id, sender_id, receiver_id, content, msg_type, is_read, read_at, created_at FROM chat_message WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, sender_id, receiver_id, content, msg_type, is_read, read_at, created_at FROM chat_message WHERE (sender_id = #{userId} AND receiver_id = #{peerId}) OR (sender_id = #{peerId} AND receiver_id = #{userId}) ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_message WHERE sender_id = #{senderId} AND receiver_id = #{receiverId} AND is_read = 0
